answers.answer: Roll one die per held office card simultaneously, add one per fatigue and +1 for Chairman. Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire. Move the member to Pensioners, flip the card into Vacant Offices, and return its fatigue to supply.

Only players who retired at least one pensioner select one display card or discard one. Order is descending actual total retirement spending; ties go to most total windows (including new prizes), then clockwise from PM. The actor may peek at display blackmails. Do not refill during selections; if empty, skip remaining eligible players. Then discard all remaining display cards, refill exactly three (prestige faceup, blackmail facedown), and return all pensioners to supplies.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure → London Season, Retirements and Prestige.

answers.answer: At phase start check whether the opportunity marker matches the chosen main action. A matching action may be taken twice; otherwise once. Move the marker to the chosen action. Only the latest passed extra-action law may grant an extra action; it is never doubled and does not move the marker. Enlist Writer with at least four vacant offices adds one writer once this turn, so a doubled Writer action places three total.

After family actions, while Debt and applicants remain, move the rightmost applicant into Court and lower Debt one, repeating. If Debt is gone, slide remaining applicants as far right as possible preserving order. Seek Share money is paid to the bank, never Company treasuries.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure → Family, New Company shares.

answers.answer: Fill vacancies in ascending number on card backs. Own-family ordinary hiring needs verbal consent from every other player represented in the candidate pool; Chairman election and Commander appointment are exempt. On promotion transfer fatigue to the new card and insert the old card as vacant in ascending order. If there is no candidate or hirer, skip it; office stays vacant and takes no actions, including hiring.

Former Chairman announces the number of shares needed for a pure majority (more than half current shares). Any shareholder may campaign; the first candidate supported by players controlling that many shares wins. If nobody reaches it, former Chairman chooses any shareholder, including self. The winner moves one Company share into the Chairman slot; it still counts as a share for dividends, majority and scoring, but cannot be traded or invested in a firm.

Commit resources and office-treasury cash first; cash for a Company-office check comes from that acting office and is paid to bank. Gather dice and subtract penalties; use the lowest die: 1–2 succeeds, 3–4 fails and can retry if resources and limits permit, 5–6 is catastrophic, ends that office’s actions, returns officeholder to supply, discards fatigue and flips card to Vacant Offices. Specific procedures can modify this. Do not take dead actions with no effect or chance of success (e.g. trade with no ship).

Chairman may add up to three Debt freely, each adding £5 to Balance. Each further advance needs consent of players controlling a majority of Company shares (Chairman counts); never pass the Debt track end. Then allocate all Balance to other office treasuries, reducing Balance by each transfer. Borrowing and allocation may be interleaved within those limits; cash already in offices remains there.

Shipping must spend until £2 or less remains. Lease an extra ship for £2; fit a ship from a shipyard for £3 without owner consent; buy a Company ship for £5 only if no ships remain on shipyards. Place acquired ships in any sea zone, including China once it exists. Extra ships last only until Refresh.

Declare home region plus only regions reachable through open orders with available ship capacity. Each £1 of Presidency treasury buys a die; subtract one per declared nonhome region. A successful Trade fills at most one order per ship in that Presidency’s sea zone, tracing a connected route: first writer goes to home port, each later order extends this Trade’s route. Use all writers then filled-order tokens for remaining ships; tokens extend the route too. Other Presidency writers cannot extend it, and no President may fill another President’s home. President gets £1/order, writer owners £1/writer; Company Balance gains listed value, or half rounded down for an order a firm filled this turn. At most one successful Trade per President per turn; failure/retries stay within its uninterrupted opportunity.

Target own Presidency’s home, associated region, or a region bordering an associated region; not another home or another Presidency’s Company region. A Company target must have unrest or a closed order to matter. Exhaust chosen officers/regiments for one die each and local alliances for printed dice; subtract strength of target and all other regions in its empire (target counted once; Company defense is zero). After every attempt owners roll one die per officer exhausted in that attempt; each 6 returns that officer to supply. Regiments do not roll losses.

On success take loot of £4 per target tower plus faceup loot modifier, with minimum equal to surviving participating officers this attempt +1 for Commander. Pay repeated cycles: Commander family £1 for Commander and £1 per own used surviving officer; then other families clockwise £1 per used surviving officer; bank last £1 per used regiment and local-alliance piece. Repeat until loot is distributed. Commander gets one trophy per target tower. Then remove target tower/dome (and all matching flags if capital), open all target orders and clear unrest, put control token symbol-side up above associated President’s box, Governor overlay in region and only Governor card in Vacant Offices on new non-GG conquest; move Elephant fully inside if it faced outward. On catastrophe, Commander returns half own-family trophies rounded up and member to supply; exhausted officers still check losses; Commander has no office card.
answers.evidence: Actions → Commanders and Deploy; successful control table; catastrophe paragraph.

answers.answer: Use printed dice pool. Each attempt rolls current pool without penalty, then reduces pool by one regardless. Success takes £1, or £2 if immediately preceding roll was unsuccessful, then exactly one option: build ship one stage, commission regiment, or tax £2 unsplit to Balance or associated President treasury. First build success places partial ship in Governor’s region; a later success completes it into associated President’s sea zone. Commissioned regiment goes in associated Army. Each Tax after first this turn adds regional unrest. Any unsuccessful roll adds unrest; catastrophe also removes holder. Repeat until stop, no dice, or catastrophe.

Reduce Balance £1 per Debt, each officer/regiment in Armies and each ship in sea zones including China; exclude Commanders. If short, take £5 emergency loans, advancing Debt only while track space remains; at max Debt keep taking loans without further advance. New emergency Debt adds no current-turn expense. After loans set Balance to zero; one/two loans lower Standing one, three or more lower it two. Compare remaining Balance to expectations under current Standing and lower Standing one if short. Then Chairman may pay affordable dividends at one cash per Company share, paying £1/share to each owner including self; if total dividends strictly exceed expectations, raise Standing one.

An attack on a Company region also triggers secondary rebellions in every other unrest Company region. Resolve primary Crisis first, then secondary regions in Bombay, Madras, Bengal Army order; within each Presidency its Commander orders associated regions. Primary normal Crisis strength is normal attack plus unrest in target; Foreign Invasion primary uses ordinary attack die only. Each secondary strength is only its unrest cubes. Defense is chosen by associated Commander, or Military Affairs if Commander vacant, or Chairman if both vacant; latter two gain/lose no trophies. Exhaust active Army pieces equal to strength, or as many as possible. Equal exhausted strength means attack fails: clear unrest, Commander gains trophy; defeated normal primary Invasion also removes one attacker tower if possible. Unequal means attack succeeds and Region Loss applies. Excess indivisible-alliance counting remains unresolved in summary.
answers.evidence: Events in India → Attacks on Company; Mounting defense table; Unresolved counting boundary.

answers.answer: PM draws at least one law. After one or two ordinary laws PM may stop or draw up to three total, then chooses one revealed and discards others. A dilemma forces its selection and ends drawing. Before vote, move dial clockwise or counterclockwise to the first matching bottom-icon policy space; that fixes target/consequence. Votes resolve at support -1 or less as fail (discard; dilemma failure text; Opposition Leader returns token/takes dial; new PM moves proposed policy one adjacent space and resolves it), or zero+ as pass (place law among passed laws, PM takes token, resolve selected policy then immediate law effects). Restore used cards afterward. If law causes failure, finish vote before scoring.

At start before London in 1758/Long 1710, PM may call a special vote if Standing and/or Debt is on a lined space, and must if either is on a starred space. Use ordinary voting threshold/procedure with exceptions: passing lowers Debt one per two current Debt, sets Standing to S, awards PM passed-law token and activates firms; no policy accompanies it. Failing increases Company-share scoring value by flipping/placing Court VP token; it does not remove PM or discard law, and PM may vote against. 1813 starts deregulated.

Only if you currently manage no firm, form one by returning an eligible Company share to supply or flipping a workshop to invested; flip family board to firm charter, place family member as first share, set value cube to leftmost and take £5 from bank into London. To invest with manager consent, contribute a Company share or workshop for a firm share and £5 from bank into London. At most ten shares; further contributions still add £5 but no share. Cannot contribute Chairman share; cannot use Company shares if Standing or Debt is on lined space, nor shares created this turn even if traded away. Invested workshops stay invested even after firm failure, without bonus or Company-failure VP.

Each firm gets exactly one attempt; only one with a ship may choose trade. Managers simultaneously and secretly choose trade zone/home port plus London cash bid, or Hobnob; reveal bids, keep strategies facedown until matching Presidency. At Presidency start, before actions, reveal matching strategies, roll one die per bid £1 (pay bid to bank); any 1/2 permits trade. Initiative is ship count minus successful dice (1/2), possibly negative; President’s successful Trade creates initiative likewise. Fill lowest initiative first; President picks tied order. If President vacant or never trades, firms fill after Commander/Governors, with Chairman breaking initiative ties. Fill open orders up to ships+1, starting home and tracing own filled route; each firm only once per order. Earlier-filled order pays half rounded down. India treasury gets revenue; raise Value one per full £6 added this turn.

At Revenue firms pay £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm Value, from either/both treasuries. If unable, dissolve unless rescued: shares to Debtor’s Prison at -1 VP each, ships to matching shipyards, charter flips family-side; workshops remain invested. Emergency investments follow share/workshop rules even if ten-share cap prevents shares; pay expenses, lose remaining cash, lower Value one per emergency investment. Or emergency merger with one other firm, whose shareholders all consent; other firm first pays its own expenses if not yet paid, then covers endangered firm’s unpaid expenses. After expenses manager may pay dividends from India treasury: each dividend is £1 per share plus £1 manager. Waiver requires shareholder and manager consent. Record actual cash paid in Company Balance track; active non-Hobnob paying none records zero; Hobnob keeps prior marker. Sweep remaining India money to London.

Components are limited; when supply runs out complete as much as possible. Cash, trophy/passed-law tokens, dice and regiments may use proxies. Company Balance, VP and Vote tracks are unlimited. All info including discards and family cash is public, except facedown blackmail and temporarily concealed firm strategies/bids.

Tradeable: enterprises, facedown blackmail, family cash, Company/firm shares and promise cards. Not tradeable: officeholders, writers, officers, prizes, spouses, trophies, passed laws, played blackmail, PM dial or Chairman piece. For share transfer return old owner’s family member and replace it at same location with receiving family member; adjust VP if luxury ownership changes. Played faceup blackmail cannot be traded.

Immediate transfers are binding; future-behavior promises are not, except printed promise-card guaranteed effects can be called if possible. Follow card timing/limits; no promise calls in Final Scoring. If simultaneous calls cannot all be fulfilled, guarantor chooses which. Promise cards can transfer to a third party or guarantor. Transferred resources cannot activate twice (e.g. a workshop already paid this Bonuses phase does not pay again after sale).

For five players add three extra setup cards; for six add six, then shuffle/deal evenly. Place every listed holding: cash and enterprises, office members/cards, Company-share members in Court, writers/officers/trainees in indicated boxes, Commander in Army slot without office card, ships in listed sea zones or on shipyards if unfitted. Each starting luxury gives 2 VP. Shuffle prestige and blackmail together into one deck; deal three for London display, prestige faceup and blackmail facedown.

Game ends after scenario final turn or when Standing reaches failure. Failure during Revenue goes immediately to Final Scoring; during Events finish Events before scoring; legislation failure finishes the vote before scoring. Once game over, stop negotiations, promise calls and blackmail except a card allowing final-scoring use; during all Final Scoring no negotiations or promise calls.
answers.evidence: Revenue; Events in India → Region Loss; Parliament Resolution; Scoring / Victory Conditions.

answers.answer: Power counts enterprises and Company shares at current track rates, plus passed-law tokens and trophies (+1 each), PM (+2) and printed card power (blackmail faceup/down, applicable spouse). First/second awards: turns 1–3 = 3/1 VP; 4–6 = 5/2; 7–8 = 8/4. Tied first each get only the lower award; no other award. Tied second get none. Highest final VP wins; tie goes to most windows, then clockwise from PM.

Firm scoring happens first if deregulated. For each player, total VP from all firm shares, then round that total down once; deduct 1 VP per own family piece in Debtor’s Prison. If Company survives, add Court VP/share value; if it fails, subtract that value/share and add 1 VP per uninvested workshop (invested workshops do not score). Survived: final office attrition and Pensioner retirements, no display. Failed: instead draw one random failure card. Firm special retirement occurs before Power or other ordinary scoring in either outcome.
answers.evidence: Scoring → Final Scoring order; Court/workshops; outcome table.

answers.answer: Spouses usually add VP, impose permanent restrictions and cannot be transferred. Take required enterprise/share trades immediately on acquiring spouse. Retirement discounts stack, are personal, and each may be used once per London Season and once during Final Scoring; they reduce actual spending and display priority.

Whether returned due to Violet Effingham or unpaid tax, fitted ship stays in play. That shipyard cannot be purchased while matching ship remains in play; it becomes purchasable after the ship returns.

Enlist Writer: place member in any Presidency Writers box; with ≥4 vacant offices add one extra once this turn. Enlist Officer: place member in Officers-in-Training. Purchase Luxury: pay bank £4; gain luxury, 2 VP while owned and window icon; social enterprise. Purchase Shipyard: pay bank £2; take shipyard and place matching ship unfitted on it; shipping enterprise, one vote and £1 bonus while fitted. Purchase Workshop: pay bank £5; manufacturing enterprise, two votes, £1 bonus, worth 1 VP if Company fails unless invested. Seek Share: member to empty Stock Exchange space; pay bank queue cost £2, £3, £3, £4 or £5; applicant not yet share.

If a required family piece is unavailable in supply, take one from any of your prizes and lose that prize’s printed VP; this includes firm-share creation. If no family action is possible, take none and return opportunity marker to supply.
answers.evidence: Family phase, forced reuse and no-action rule.

answers.answer: If Court is empty, former Chairman automatically returns as Chairman. Place a member from supply, or if needed/possible take one from a prize and lose its VP. If impossible, there is no Chairman.

Chairman hires Director of Trade (chooses current officeholder except Chairman/Governor; if all offices vacant, any writer), Manager of Shipping (any writer), and Military Affairs (Presidential Commander, else officer, else trainee). Director hires Presidents from a writer of that Presidency or Governor associated with it. Associated President hires Governor from writer or officer in region (Commander is not an officer). Chairman hires China Superintendent from any writer immediately when created. Governor General replaces Director and hires like Director. Commanders are not officeholders for Director selection.
answers.evidence: Hiring → offices/candidates; China and Governor General sections.

answers.answer: Director may make repeated Special Envoy checks, each costing £1 treasury per die and no penalty. Success either opens one closed order in non-Company region or opens China by placing overlay/card and Chairman immediately hiring a writer. After all envoys, may transfer up to two writers or ships between any Presidencies/sea zones, including China once created. Cannot transfer until finished with envoys.

Military Affairs may make up to two transfers, each officer/regiment Army to Army, staying in top half; then assign every trainee to any Army top half. Finally appoint Commanders if vacancy or another family has more total pieces than incumbent: choose among families with most pieces, move chosen officer to Commander slot, return previous Commander to Army top as officer. Tied incumbent stays. Nepotism does not apply.

Each President chooses order of its Commander, Governors and own Trade. Commander/Governors get opportunity but may decline; each finishes all actions before next, Trade cannot interrupt another position. If President vacant, Chairman sets order only and cannot Trade or approve local alliance purchases.

Trade does not exhaust ships. At Refresh, writers on orders return to their associated Presidency Writers box (use dividers to preserve affiliation); filled tokens and dividers return to supply. Fitted player ships keep fatigue.
answers.evidence: Actions → Presidency operations; Upkeep and Refresh.

answers.answer: At start of Commander operations, before Deploy, request President treasury funds for printed-price local alliances; President must approve. Move purchased alliance to active/top. Used for Deploy or defense, exhaust whole alliance to bottom; strength usable once that turn and cannot split between purposes. Refresh exhausts unused active alliances too; it does not reactivate them as it does officers/regiments.

Against own Company region, defense penalty is zero and no towers remain, hence no tower trophies. To reopen orders/clear unrest, a successful Deploy still has minimum loot of surviving participating officers plus £1 for Commander when no tower or faceup loot modifier; distribute normally.

Two successful stages total: first successful Build when no partial ship places it in Governor’s region; next success completes it into sea zone associated with Governor’s President. Each successful Build is only one stage. Commissioned regiment goes into Army associated with Governor’s President; officer-like strength, loot paid to bank, no officer-loss rolls.

China is created by successful Special Envoy or Envoy to China law; in either case Chairman immediately hires any writer. Its treasury holds ships, not cash. Shipping/Director may send ships there; they count Eastern for expenses/events/storms/laws. China acts after Bengal and may attempt trade once total, including failed attempt. Do not attempt without an export icon in Company-controlled regions.

China rolls one die per ship and cannot retry; no trade attempt without at least one export icon in Company-controlled regions. On success count export icons only in Company-controlled regions: Company Balance receives £4 times number of icons, Superintendent’s family receives £1 per icon from bank. Non-Company exports count for neither.
answers.evidence: Actions → Superintendent of Trade in China.

answers.answer: Governor General law makes Governors pensioners, removes overlays and partial ships, returns Governor/Director cards to box, replaces Director with Governor General preserving holder/fatigue and ribbon position. Conquests create no Governor/overlay; printed Company symbols show control. Region loss skips Governor Elimination.

Before checks add £3 Balance per Company region. Govern repeatedly with £1 treasury per die, no penalty, but at most one success per turn. Every rolled 6 adds unrest in each Company region even on success; failure adds another unrest to every Company region. Success gives £1 per Company region and requires one benefit per region: completed ship to any sea zone including China, regiment to any Army, or £2 to Balance/any office treasury except own, with unrest added to a Company region. Multiple Tax choices this turn put unrest in different regions.

Storm checks occur after eligibility identified, once per eligible ship in affected zone: 1–2 nothing; 3–4 fatigue, or sink if already fatigued; 5–6 sink. Company and extra ships are exempt. China-assigned ships count Eastern. Firm ships count zone on strategy; Hobnob ships exempt. A sunk ship returns to shipyard unfatigued.

On newly closed order, return any writer there to owner’s supply; flip filled token to closed. If instructed to close in fully closed region, Cascade by closing all open orders directly connected; if a connected order is already closed, close that region’s northernmost open order instead. If none open, it too Cascades. A region initiates Cascade only once per tile, but can receive multiple Cascades’ effects.
answers.evidence: Events in India → Closing orders and Cascades.

answers.answer: Turmoil closes northernmost open order in top-stack region; if all closed, Cascade. Windfall gives owners £1 per writer on orders in top-stack region and every bordering region. Shuffle: Elephant’s March, shuffle tile into remaining draw stack; separately shuffle discards and place atop it. If draw stack empty, March last instead.

Leader: top-stack sovereign region gains one tower. Dominated region instead rebels with printed explosion modifier. March only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region that successfully rebelled.

Peace on a border opens orders connected across Elephant border and adds one tower to each touched non-Company region, then Marches. If Elephant wholly inside a region, instead open all its orders and remove its unrest, then March.

For non-Company Invasion, attacker’s whole empire strength plus event modifier must be strictly greater than defender’s whole empire strength. Success replaces defender flag with attacker’s dominated flag; taking a capital shatters its whole empire. If attacker lacks an empire, use free capital/star and matching small flag; if none available, no empire/flags form. Failure costs attacker one tower. Equal does not win.

For non-Company Rebellion, compare only actor region strength plus modifier with sovereign capital strength; other empire regions do not count. Must be strictly greater, so tie fails. Success makes actor sovereign, removes its flag and closes all its orders (Cascade if already closed). Failure removes one tower from capital.

On Region Loss, Commander returns half family trophies rounded up and member returns to supply. Roll once per officer in Army; each 6 removes it. Return Governor card, fatigue/member to supplies and remove overlay, partial ship and unrest. Restore dome with one tower (or Foreign Invasion specified strength) and appropriate invasion flag. Return control token to region with £ loot side down, region-symbol side up; region loses Presidency association. Close orders for Invasion Crisis, Cascading if already closed; Rebellion/Foreign Invasion already close them. Standing loss is number lost so far this turn: first -1, second additional -2, etc. Loss does not automatically remove other Company regions; resolve each separately.

After successful Invasion Crisis Elephant moves to successful capital (Imperial Ambitions); otherwise to top-stack region. Inside Company region place fully inside. In dominated region point toward sovereign; in sovereign region point across shape-marked border on tile. If that neighbor is already dominated by actor, choose first clockwise neighbor not dominated; if all are dominated, use redirect-arrow border pointing toward empire capital.

Foreign Invasion rolls storm die for target regions: West Bombay, South Madras, East Bengal; all storms means each target; none means top-stack region. For each target ordinary die gives attack strength. On success close all orders (Cascade if already all closed), remove target flag and matching flags if capital, restore dome if Company-controlled, set tower strength to half attack roll rounded down. March with circle shape only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region that was invaded.
answers.evidence: Events in India → Foreign Invasion; FAQ ruling.

answers.answer: PM must draw at least one law. After one or two ordinary non-dilemma draws may stop or continue up to three total; choose one revealed, discard rest. Dilemma forces its selection and ends drawing. Before voting move dial clockwise or counterclockwise, stopping at the first policy space matching chosen law’s bottom icon; that space fixes target/consequence.

Tax: each family pays bank £1 per owned target; unpaid targets return to supply, including Chairman; ship stays if shipyard lost, and VP from prize/luxury is lost. Window tax additionally charges each enterprise and prize window; return it if unable. Bonus: bank pays each family £1 per owned target. Power: swap target marker with next higher marker; if already highest, swap any other pair.

Starting PM clockwise, each player casts votes; £1 family cash buys one plus printed card votes. A card’s votes usable once total during whole vote: rotate when used until resolution. PM may call full additional rounds or stop after each; round with no votes must end voting.

A player who voted for may later oppose; once opposed cannot support in this vote. Track all opposition; largest total holds Opposition Leader, tied current holder retains. With recipient consent, votes may be cast for someone already opposed or committing to oppose and count toward their total. PM cannot oppose or consent to enterprises opposing, except forced ‘Vote with my enterprises’ promise.

Final-turn upkeep still happens. Pay printed upkeep per prize member; if unpaid return member and lose that prize’s VP. On final turn skip Refresh and go to scoring. Otherwise writers return to associated Writers boxes; filled tokens/dividers and extra ships to supply; exhausted Army officers/regiments reactivate; active alliances exhaust and do not reactivate; fitted player ships retain fatigue.

Each shareholder may make one extra London Season retirement from supply, regardless of firms owned. Actual spend after spouse discounts cannot exceed highest total dividend marker among firms where shareholder owns a share; printed cost may exceed marker if discounts cover difference. No retirement from firm with absent/zero marker. At Final Scoring, score firms then allow one special retirement from supply before Power/ordinary scoring, regardless of Company outcome; no display cards.

Investment £5 always comes from bank into London; trade proceeds go to India. London pays ship acquisition, bids and expenses; either/both treasuries pay expenses; India alone pays dividends; leftover India money sweeps to London. Family cash cannot move into or out of firm treasuries.
answers.evidence: Deregulation treasury rules; firm trade and expense sections.

answers.answer: Firms phase follows Family share creation and precedes Hiring. Investment actions continue without set order until nobody wants more; manager resolves timing within firm, PM between firms, then strategies are chosen.

Fit ship from shipyard for £3 from firm London treasury to bank, with shipyard owner consent. May buy player-owned ship already in Company with owner consent: unfatigued £3 or fatigued £2 paid into Shipping treasury. Cannot acquire Company or extra ships.

Only player managing no firm may initiate takeover; having another firm disqualifies. Get consent from holders of majority of target shares. Move target ships, money and shares to own charter, copy both cube positions; former manager returns cubes and flips board to family side.

Managers negotiate and every shareholder consents. Highest-value firm primary; tie resolved by players. Transfer all secondary shares, ships and treasury funds to primary; secondary boards flip to family sides; share transfers negotiable. If primary exceeds ten shares, return excess shares to owners’ supplies with those owners’ consent. Primary value/dividend track continues.
Hobnob means no bid, trade or dividends; still pays expenses and retains previous dividend marker for retirement. Its ships are exempt from storms.

Yes, emergency investment may still contribute a Company share/workshop and £5 even if ten-share cap means no new share. It follows normal eligibility rules (including share restrictions and no same-turn-created Company shares); pay expenses, lose remaining cash, lower Value once per emergency investment. Summary describes no separate end to same-turn-share restriction.

Emergency merger is with only one other firm. Normal merger rules apply, including consent of every involved shareholder. Other firm must first pay its own expenses if not already paid, then pay endangered firm’s unpaid expenses.

All firm shareholders must consent to voluntary dissolution; apply insolvent-firm dissolution: shares go to Debtor’s Prison (-1 VP each), ships to matching shipyards, charter flips family-side. Workshops remain invested for rest of game.

Before ordinary scoring, add each player’s VP from all firm shares across all firms, then round their combined total down once; subtract 1 per their own piece in Debtor’s Prison. Firm value VP/share: 1=-1; 2=0; 3–4=½; 5–7=1; 8–9=1½; 10=2. Company survival does not change firm-share scoring; it changes Company-share/workshop scoring later.

1710 starts turn 1, ends 5, no deregulation procedures. 1758 starts 3, ends 7, begins monopoly and may vote deregulation. 1813 starts 5, ends 8, starts deregulated. Long 1710 starts 1, ends 8, same initial position as 1710, deregulation available; often twice as long.

1710: Standing £10 expectations, Debt 0, £3 each office, Royal Protection, one regiment per Army, no Company ships. 1758: Standing £12 expectations, Debt 3, £4 each office, Calico Acts, one regiment per Army, one Company ship East Indian, Bengal control token in Bengal Presidency. The summary’s setup table supplies these values.

1813: Standing £10 expectations, Debt 0, £3 each office; laws Military Oversight, Deregulation (Debtor’s Prison side), Calico Acts; two regiments per Army and one Company ship per sea zone. Put +2/−2 share-value token in Court, create China, place Bombay/Madras/Bengal control tokens in their Presidencies, return Governor General law to box and overlay over Director of Trade. Use Governor General instead of Director and no Governors. Exact map copied from reverse of scenario card.
Power award on final turn 1–3: 3 VP first, 1 second; 4–6: 5/2; 7–8: 8/4. Tied first players each get only the lower award; no other award, so tied-first receive 1, 2 or 4 respectively.

Initial Power positions: Social 2 power, Company shares 1, Shipping and Manufacturing 0. In 1758/Long 1710, lined Standing £4/6/8 or Debt 5/6/7/8 permits PM’s special Deregulation vote; starred Standing £4 or Debt 8 requires it. Standing reset S is above £10.

No. The Foreign Invasion primary attack uses ordinary attack die only; unrest does not add to strength or resulting tower levels. Successful Foreign Invasion closes all target orders once; if all already closed, Cascade. Region Loss does not close them a second time.

Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing check to zero dice means failure. Company Fraud at start Revenue: roll one die per officeholder, reduce Balance by twice highest roll (minimum zero), take from bank only cash equal to actual Balance reduction, avoiding overdraw. Public Demands Impeachment returns holder to supply and office card to vacancies. Military Oversight demotes one Commander to officer, then appoints Commander from officers; same former Commander remains eligible.

Shared setup: Balance £5; family VP markers zero. Put local alliances in named Army boxes and loot tokens money-side up in matching regions. Choose scenario card for Standing, Debt, treasuries, laws, regiments, ships and map; put Turn marker on its date and PM dial arm to matching date. India map details (towers, flags, orders, Elephant) are copied from scenario card.

Normal order: London Season → Family → Firms if deregulated → Hiring → Company Operation → Bonuses → Revenue → Events in India → Parliament Meets → Upkeep and Refresh. Special eligible Deregulation vote at turn start before London; skip London Season on game’s first turn.

If Chairman office vacant, former Chairman acts first; then clockwise each player may retire each pensioner to a prize, paying printed cost. Move pensioner to prize and gain printed VP; set actual spending aside until London Season ends to establish card selection order, then pay bank. Pensioners need not retire, but unused ones do not remain: return all to supply after display selection.

No. Whenever an empire loses its last dominated region, remove the surviving capital’s starred flag; it is no longer an empire. Applies regardless of cause, including Rebellion or Company conquest of that last dominated region.

Chairman-title holder starts Family; clockwise thereafter. New Company Shares step occurs after all players’ Family actions: if Debt and applicants remain, move rightmost applicant into Court/lower Debt repeatedly; with no Debt slide remaining applicants right preserving order.

Operation order: Chairman → Director of Trade (or Governor General) → Manager Shipping → Military Affairs → Bombay → Madras → Bengal → China Superintendent if created. Skip vacant offices. Newly created offices normally go into Vacant Offices; newly created Governorship waits for later Hiring (China hires immediately).
answers.evidence: Company Operation; Governor General / China creation.

answers.answer: Events begins by rolling storm die; resolve all indicated storms before drawing events. Eligible ships are player-owned Company-fleet ships in affected zones, China ships counted Eastern, and firm ships in strategy zone; Company/extra ships and Hobnob ships exempt. Roll once per eligible ship. The storm face gives affected sea zones and number of India events. Then flip/resolve tiles one at a time for that number; for location normally use back of new top tile, not drawn tile, subject to event rule.
answers.evidence: Events in India → First roll; Storms.

answers.answer: For ordinary Elephant-located Crisis, tail is acting/attacking region, head defender/target. Sovereign actor (large capital flag or unflagged dome) means Invasion; dominated actor (small flag or no dome) means Rebellion against sovereign. Elephant wholly inside Company region means Rebellion against Company. These large/small flags, dome, and Company control identify status; Foreign Invasion has separate location rule.
